blocks.text: Mastering Word for claims adjusters on Mac

Claims adjusters juggle dozens of files daily. Your Mac environment needs to be set up to handle this load without slowing you down. Microsoft Word on Mac version 16.114.1 offers many features that help maintain strict documentation standards. Start by customizing your ribbon to include the tools you use most often. Go to Word > Preferences > Ribbon & Toolbar to add buttons for common tasks like inserting tables or changing page orientation.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for your daily workflow

Using your keyboard saves significant time compared to clicking through menus. Mac shortcuts rely on the Command key. Use ⌘ + C to copy and ⌘ + V to paste. To move through your report quickly, use Option + Left Arrow or Option + Right Arrow. This jumps the cursor by word instead of character. If you need to select a full paragraph, hold Shift + Command + Down Arrow.

items: ⌘ + F: Open the find menu to search for claim numbers.
⌘ + P: Open the print dialog for final reports.

blocks.text: Consistency is key for audit trails. Create a master template for your initial loss reports. Save this file as a .dotx file to ensure you do not overwrite your original. When you need to start a new claim, just open the template and fill in the details. This prevents you from starting from a blank page every time. Link your templates to a specific folder on your Mac desktop for quick access.
Handling complex documentation with section breaks

Long claims files often require different layouts. You might need one page in landscape orientation for photos and the rest in portrait. Use Layout > Breaks > Next Page to insert a section break. This allows you to change the orientation for just that page. It keeps your document looking professional and organized.
How to use Lazur with Word

Lazur works as a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. When you are writing a report and cannot remember where a specific tool is, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask. Lazur can point out the button or explain how to perform a task. If you have many notes to type, hold fn to dictate them directly into your Word document. This is helpful when you are reviewing site photos and need to record your observations quickly.
When you are stuck, ask Lazur to guide you through a task one step at a time. It will wait for you to finish each click before moving on.
blocks.title: Learn by doing

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Word files for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It helps you find tools, answers questions, and dictates text so you can work faster.

faq.question: Does Word for Mac have the same features as Windows?
faq.answer: Most features are the same, but you might find differences in advanced VBA or specific add-ins. Basic claims documentation works exactly the same on both.

faq.question: How do I fix Word if it crashes on my Mac?
faq.answer: Try force-quitting the app with ⌥ ⌘ Esc. If that fails, check for updates in the App Store or run First Aid in Disk Utility to check your drive permissions.
